annotation.title_clean: D’fhoilsigh an Coimisiún treoirlínte maidir le sainmhíniú ar an gcóras intleachta saorga chun cur i bhfeidhm rialacha an chéad Ghnímh um an Intleacht Shaorga a éascú
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate the application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology
annotation.summary_en: Irish-language European Commission web page announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It notes that the first AI Act rules, covering the AI system definition, AI literacy and prohibited practices, have applied since 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines on the AI system definition are non-binding and will be updated over time.
They help providers and others decide whether a system is an AI system under the AI Act.
Published alongside the guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
The AI Act classifies AI systems into risk categories: prohibited, high-risk and transparency obligations.
The first AI Act rules (definition, AI literacy, prohibitions) applied from 2 February 2025.
